author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನದೇಹವಾಲಯವು ನಿನ್ನಾತ್ಮ ಪರಮಾತ್ಮ
ನಿನ್ನ ಮಾತುಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಬೀಜಮಂತ್ರಗಳೇ
ನಿನ್ನ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯಾಗೆ ಪೂಜೆಗಿಹ ಪುಷ್ಪಗಳು
ನಿನ್ನರಿವೆ ದೇವತ್ವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Your body is the temple, your self the Supreme Self;
every word you speak is a seed-mantra;
your conduct and speech are the flowers of worship;
knowing yourself is divinity, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The body is a temple and the self within it is the Supreme. Our words can be as sacred as bīja mantras, and our conduct can be the offering of flowers. To know oneself is to be divine.
